formation.note: Approval year, used as a lower bound for the collaboration formation (the proposal predates the J/psi).
formation.quote: The experiment was approved in 1975 and completed running in 1979.

intervals.label: SPEAR and DORIS II running
intervals.note: No source states exact start and end dates. Derived: put in storage at SLAC from 1987, five years at DESY (DORIS II upgraded in 1982, Ziemann), three years before that at SPEAR, so about 1979-1982 at SPEAR and 1982-1987 at DESY.
intervals.quote: It was built at SLAC and used for meson spectroscopy measurements there for three years. It was then used at DESY for five years of experiments and put in storage at SLAC from 1987 until 1996 when it was moved to BNL by our collaboration.

intervals.label: removed from DESY; stored at SLAC
intervals.note: The e+e- programme ended with the detector going into storage; it later ran at Brookhaven (AGS) and Mainz (hadron physics, outside this record).
intervals.quote: put in storage at SLAC from 1987 until 1996 when it was moved to BNL by our collaboration

summary.plain: The collaboration of Caltech, Harvard, Princeton, SLAC and UC Santa Cruz physicists that built the Crystal Ball and ran it at SPEAR, then at DESY, led by Elliott Bloom.
summary.technical: Crystal Ball collaboration, SPEAR period (AIP catalogue lists Caltech, Harvard, Princeton, SLAC, UC Santa Cruz; spokesperson E. D. Bloom); at DORIS II a collaboration that included DESY groups; membership lists not retrieved.
